''See also: [[Heart (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Heart of Nakothi]], also referred to as the [[Dead Mother]], is a gray organ roughly the size of a human fist. It was discovered inside a cage hanging from a chain alongside the deceased Emperor. The object possesses a unique ability to bond with humans and can conform itself to an individual's [[Intent]], potentially due to personal compatibility or proximity to the Emperor. For over fifteen hundred years, the Emperor managed to keep the influence of the [[Dead Mother]] at bay, though he eventually succumbed to her awakening and died. The Heart holds immense political significance, as the individual who possesses it can claim a legitimate right to the imperial [[throne]]. Consequently, various factions seek to control it, including the [[Blackwatch]], who intend to bind the Heart to a chosen leader. Its presence is linked to the increasing activity of the [[Elders]] and carries the potential to reshape those who encounter it.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Heart is a valuable object that recently arrived on the island. Located within a crater, this gray-green organ pulses at the center of a network of veins and tendons. While the [[Consultants]] seek to obtain it, [[Calder]] is also searching for the entity. The Heart may desire a bond with a human, and its presence has become a point of conflict for the Emperor's successor, who fights over the [[Dead Mother]]'s Heart. As events unfold, the object or concept appears to be drawing closer.}}
